question: Does one centered regularized response slope improve equal-subject mean prediction beyond the same shrunk location?

cohort.selection: Exclude both exact previous cohorts, then existing complete-history hash selection; no seed search

book.split: Existing 70/15/15 static item masks and 80/20 cold masks with this new seed; no time inference

cohort.selection: Lowest release/seed/subject SHA256 among label-blind temporal-support eligible complete histories

movie.split: Global UTC cutoffs: train before 2021-01-01, validation 2021, test from 2022-01-01. All target outcomes postdate small 2018 snapshot; cross-release people overlap UNKNOWN. Hold out 100 subjects from all shared fit/validation. Regular evidence stays train-only for both validation/test. Cold evidence uses most-recent complete timestamp groups before test; stop at first group that exceeds budget. Fixed test targets for every cold budget.

objective: Squared loss sum((y-base-location-correction*(base-center))^2) + 10*location^2 + 25*correction^2; center is mean visible base. Shared base includes own train contribution identically in both variants. Bound correction to [-0.75,1]; clip both forecasts to original mapped source range.
fallback: Exact control when sparse, constant source grades, or insufficient base variance; no evidence returns shared base. Keep supported location. No forced anchors or identified psychological scale claim.
bootstrapUnit: Paired subjects, equal subject weight, percentile 95% interval per domain; no pooled cross-domain claim

decision.rule: Per domain: save validation decision before scoring holdout. Retain challenger for further research only if validation AND holdout meet gain/interval/MAE/coverage and all cold guards; require regular and cold20 spread support. Otherwise retain location-only control or record INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT. No parameter search or replacement cohort after scores.
decision.rationale: Fixed small incremental gain margin of 0.02 on mapped ten-point units; not inferred from fresh labels and not a native product threshold.

admission: NONE; no native rows, serving artifact, or commercial permission
broadPretraining: After model selection and source/use admission, a separate pre-release packet scales eligible individual observations with protected tests, learning curves, coverage, resource bounds, reproducible artifact and rollback. This bounded experiment is not full-source pretraining.
